Fisher.description: Raised along coastal tides with exceptional balancing skills.

features.name: Fisher Shoony
features.tldr: You gain bonuses to balance checks and resist being knocked down on slippery terrain.

Tinker.description: Gifted with manual dexterity and quick repair habits for tools.

features.name: Tinker Shoony
features.tldr: You gain trained proficiency in Crafting and bonuses when repairing gear.
